now.evidence: The owner-packet evaluator and this frozen specification agree on the twelve required input names, flow shape and 300-cent cap.
now.value: Makes the exact missing inputs visible without weakening the canary safety boundary.
now.why_now: The remaining safe bottleneck is owner-local preparation, not another historical reconstruction or execution build.
